name: StatedBot0
source:
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- Cooperate when the opponent is provably cooperative with me and
    provably defects against DefectBot; otherwise defect. -/
def StatedBot0 (k : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k (.plays .opp .self Action.C)
    (.search (2 * k + 64) (.plays .opp (.bot DefectBot) Action.D)
      (.const Action.C)
      (.const Action.D))
    (.const Action.D)

end PD.Bots

      (.const Action.D)
